        HEYA Talent Solutions is the workforce and recruitment division of HEYA Limited, supporting businesses, government agencies, contractors, and project developers across Papua New Guinea.

    Vision & Mission
    
      
        Vision
        PNG's trusted talent acquisition partner
        To become Papua New Guinea's leading Strategic Talent Acquisition Partner, delivering innovative workforce solutions that empower businesses and transform careers.
      
      
        Mission
        Reliable, strategic workforce solutions
        To provide professional, reliable, and tailored recruitment and workforce solutions that help organizations achieve operational excellence through quality talent acquisition and workforce management.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        What We Do
        Built for Faster, Smarter Hiring in PNG
      
      HEYA Talent Solutions partners with organizations to provide skilled personnel, workforce planning, recruitment services, labour hire, onboarding support, and workforce management solutions.
    
    
      
        01
        Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
        Permanent, contract, casual, executive, skilled workforce, technical, trade, and volume recruitment support.
      
      
        02
        Labour Hire & Workforce Solutions
        Labour hire, mobilization, site-based support, shutdown workforce supply, and workforce coordination.
      
      
        03
        Onboarding & Mobilization
        Employee onboarding, medical and compliance coordination, documentation, logistics, and pre-employment support.
      
      
        04
        HR, Training & Talent Marketing
        HR advisory, workforce administration, job-ready programs, recruitment marketing, and employer branding support.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        Industries
        Industries We Serve
        HEYA Talent Solutions supports workforce and recruitment needs across resources, infrastructure, public sector, commercial, community, and professional service industries.
      
      
        
          Workforce Coverage

            >

              Support for upstream, downstream, logistics, camp, and specialist workforce demand.
            
          
          
            
              
            
            
              Construction & Infrastructure
              Project-ready candidates for civil, building, infrastructure, mechanical, and engineering delivery teams.
            
          
          
            
              
            
            
              Government & Public Sector
              Structured support for administration, technical services, and program workforce needs.
            
          
          
            
              
            
            
              Private Business & Commercial

        Why Choose Us
        Why Employers Choose HEYA Talent Solutions
      
      
        
          
            Local Industry Knowledge
            Built around Papua New Guinea's workforce environment, local content expectations, and industry recruitment challenges.
          
        
        
          
            Professional Recruitment Network
            A growing talent network helps source qualified and experienced personnel across multiple industries.
          
        
        
          
            Tailored Workforce Solutions
            Recruitment and workforce strategies are customized around each client's operational and project needs.
          
        
        
          
            Commitment to Quality
            Focused on competent, compliant, and work-ready personnel.
          
        
        
          
            Strategic Partnership Approach
            Working with clients as long-term workforce partners, not just service providers.
          
        
      
    
  

  
    
      
        Packages
        Employer Packages Built Around Hiring Outcomes
        Choose the level of visibility and recruitment support that matches your vacancy urgency, hiring volume, and workforce goals.
      
      Explore Package Options
    
    
      
        Listing Visibility
        Silver Package
        For employers who need a professional vacancy presence and a clear pathway for interested candidates.
        
          Structured vacancy placement
          Standard employer enquiry support
          Suitable for single-role visibility
        
        Best for straightforward vacancy advertising.
      
      
        Priority Reach
        Bronze Package
        For teams managing recurring vacancies or needing stronger visibility across priority candidate segments.
        
          Multiple vacancy posting support
          Featured listing placement
          Candidate pipeline visibility
        
        Best for active hiring cycles.
      
      
        Premium / Recommended
        Strategic Partnership
        Gold Package
        For employers who need deeper recruitment support, stronger market reach, and a more hands-on workforce pipeline.
        
          Premium vacancy visibility
          Dedicated recruitment support
          Candidate sourcing and screening focus
        
        Best for critical or high-volume workforce needs.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        Founder Credibility
        Founded by Hekeria Yako
        With 15 years of industry experience in end-to-end recruitment in mining across Papua New Guinea, Hekeria Yako brings practical recruitment leadership, workforce mobilization experience, and a strong industry network across PNG.

        Learn About HEYA Limited
      
      
        15 years of industry experience

      About
      HEYA Talent Solutions
      A division of HEYA Limited and Strategic Talent Acquisition Partner for Papua New Guinea.
    
  

  
    
      Company Overview
      Papua New Guinean-Owned. Workforce Focused.
    
    
      
        HEYA Limited
        A Papua New Guinean-owned company operating as a Strategic Talent Acquisition Partner, delivering professional recruitment, workforce, and talent solutions across Papua New Guinea.
      
      
        HEYA Talent Solutions
        The workforce and recruitment division of HEYA Limited, established to support organizations with reliable, professional, and industry-focused human capital solutions.
      
      
        HEYA STAP
        A strategic partner for businesses, government agencies, contractors, and project developers that need skilled personnel and practical workforce support.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        HEYA Talent Solutions
        Built for PNG's High-Demand Workforce Sectors
        With deep understanding of Papua New Guinea's labour market and industry requirements, HEYA Talent Solutions connects the right people with the right opportunities while helping organizations build productive, compliant, and sustainable workforces.
      
      
        
          
        
        
          Skilled personnel and workforce planning
          Recruitment services and labour hire
          Onboarding and mobilization support
          Workforce management solutions
          Talent marketing and employer visibility
        
      
    
  

  
    
      Company Backing
      Backed by HEYA Limited
      HEYA Limited operates HEYA Talent Solutions as its focused recruitment and workforce solutions division, supporting talent acquisition strategy, recruitment operations, labour hire, workforce mobilization, and long-term client partnerships.
    
    
      
        HEYA Limited
        Registered PNG company focused on workforce solutions.
      
      
        HY STAP
        Strategic talent acquisition capability focused on recruitment operations, workforce mobilization, labour hire, and recruitment partnerships.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        Founder Story
        Founded by Hekeria Yako
        Founded by Hekeria Yako, HEYA Limited was created to connect Papua New Guineans with real employment opportunities while supporting businesses with practical recruitment and workforce solutions.
      
      
        Built on 15 years of industry experience in end-to-end recruitment in mining across Papua New Guinea.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        Vision
        PNG's leading Strategic Talent Acquisition Partner
        To become Papua New Guinea's leading Strategic Talent Acquisition Partner, delivering innovative workforce solutions that empower businesses and transform careers.
      
      
        Mission
        Reliable, strategic workforce solutions
        To provide professional, reliable, and tailored recruitment and workforce solutions that help organizations achieve operational excellence through quality talent acquisition and workforce management.
      
    
  

  
    
      Core Values
      How We Work
    
    
      
        Integrity
        We operate with honesty, professionalism, and transparency in every engagement.
      
      
        Excellence
        We strive to deliver high-quality recruitment and workforce services that exceed client expectations.
      
      
        Partnership
        We build long-term relationships through collaboration, trust, and mutual success.
      
      
        Reliability
        We provide dependable workforce solutions that support business continuity and operational performance.
      
      
        Innovation
        We embrace modern recruitment strategies, technology, and workforce solutions to meet evolving industry demands.
      
    
  

  
    
      
        Founder Track Record
        Founder Track Record
      
      Hekeria Yako brings 15 years of industry experience in end-to-end recruitment in mining across Papua New Guinea. These points are founder career highlights, not unverified company achievements.
    
    
      
        15 Years of Industry Experience
        Recruitment, workforce planning, and HR operations across major resource-sector and workforce-intensive environments.
      
      
        Large-Scale Workforce Transition
        Experience supporting major redundancy and workforce transition exercises with professionalism and structure.
      
      
        Porgera Mine Restart Recruitment Campaign
        Experience contributing to a major recruitment drive involving more than 2,500 employees within 6 months.
      
      
        Recruitment Efficiency Improvement
        Experience improving recruitment turnaround from long-cycle hiring toward faster, more practical hiring timelines.
      
      
        Gender Diversity Leadership
        Experience supporting workforce inclusion and improved female participation in mining workforce environments.
      
      
        Strong PNG Industry Network
        Connected across recruiters, HR professionals, employers, resource-sector stakeholders, private business, and government networks in Papua New Guinea.
      
    
  

  
    
      Connecting talent. Empowering business. Building the future.
